It asks for evidence objective.

Alternatively, since parent requirement includes "person born between 1948 and 1952 in a place..." maybe the residual is to establish the birth period of the target person. But target person identity unknown. The place demographic condition is a prerequisite to identify birthplace. Which is more coherent? The parent requirement is about person born in such place. Without target identity, both are unknown. The question says "If no substantive part supported, still choose one faithful, low-commitment facet... Do not pretend unique decomposition." So either is okay. Need maybe choose one coherent part. I think demographic place condition is more self-contained. But if we choose place, we are not linking to person. However it's inside R2. The local_residual should preserve participant roles and relation. Maybe: "Establish the place of birth for the target person as a place that, according to an official website of the country where it is located, had a population increase of 5.88% between 2010 and 2020." This includes target person's birthplace. But it assumes target person known? We can phrase as evidence objective: "Establish that the target person's birthplace is a place whose population increased by 5.88% between 2010 and 2020 according to an official website of the country in which that place is located." This is one facet (birthplace being such a place). But also birth between 1948-1952 not included. Maybe we can choose the demographic condition alone. The schema says local_residual string. We need used_claims [].

Need ensure no search query/source/website? The requirement itself mentions official website; can preserve. "according to one official website of the country in which it is located" is part of condition. We can phrase objective: "Determine which place (if any) satisfies the condition that its population increased by 5.88% between 2010 and 2020 according to an official website of the country in which it is located." That is a search-like objective but not query. It's an evidence objective.

But maybe better: "Establish the demographic condition on the target person's birthplace: that the place of birth experienced a 5.88% population increase between 2010 and 2020 according to an official website of the country where the place is located." This is coherent. It doesn't ask birth years. Good.
